The daughter of Nigerian billionaire businessman and philanthropist, Tony Elumelu, Ogechukwu Elumelu, has graduated from the University of Oxford with a Master of Science degree and completed a law conversion course. Her father announced the achievement in a post shared on his X account on Saturday, describing the two accomplishments as major milestones. “Oxford MSc Graduation and Law Conversion Completed! Two major milestones. One incredible TOEGirl! Congratulations, Oge. So proud of you!” he wrote. Elumelu also shared a video showing him celebrating with his daughter. Ogechukwu, also known as Tamara-Marie Oge Elumelu, is the eldest daughter of Tony Elumelu and his wife, Dr Awele Elumelu. She previously graduated with honours from the London School of Economics and Political Science, where she studied Politics and Philosophy. She is also the host of the podcast Africa & Everywhere: Conversations with Oge, which features discussions with African entrepreneurs, business leaders and changemakers. In 2026, she organised the Africa & Everywhere Festival in Lagos, a careers and internship fair aimed at connecting young Nigerians with employment and professional opportunities.
